title: Component
description: An instantiation of a mechanism definition within a parent mechanism. `definition` is either a stable id referencing a reusable mechanism defined elsewhere (permitting the same definition to be instantiated multiple times without duplication), or a mechanism definition nested inline.

id.description: Stable identifier for this component instance within its parent mechanism.

kind.description: Self-describing discriminator; always "submechanism" for a Component.

definition.description: The mechanism this component instantiates: either a stable id referencing a mechanism defined elsewhere, or a MechanismDefinition nested inline.

mount.description: Where this component attaches within its parent, by frame and/or named interface.

frame.description: The parent-side frame this component is mounted at.

interface.description: The parent-side named interface this component is mounted at.

transform.description: The relative pose of this component with respect to its mount point.

parameters.description: Free-form parameter overrides applied to the referenced mechanism definition for this instance.

metadata.description: Opaque, application-defined data carried alongside this component.
